newsitem.title: USA: DCX Inc hires adviser for growth.
newsitem.headline: DCX Inc hires adviser for growth.

text.p: DCX Inc said on Friday it hired Transition Partners Ltd to advise the company regarding its growth and acquisition strategy.
The company said Transition Partners would help DCX reposition itself for substantial growth during the next 12 to 24 months.

DCX President Stephen Carreker said the company's plans included reducting overhead, enhancing base business profit via strategic marketing and pricing, raising capital and expanding through selective acquisitons of high tech companies and product lines."
Carreker said the company's goal was to become a $15 million to $18 million company.
